text: Azimut Holding S.p.A., an asset and wealth management group, is listed on the Milan stock exchange. Borsa Italiana's company profile (shareholder data from Azimut Holding, last updated 21 November 2025) lists Timone Fiduciaria S.r.l. with 21.15%, Helikon Investments Limited with 5.82%, treasury shares of 0.77% and a free float of 72.26%. Azimut says about 2,000 of its financial advisors, managers and staff are shareholders under a shareholders' agreement that controls about 21% of the company.
short: Azimut Holding is listed in Milan; Timone Fiduciaria (21.15%) and Helikon Investments (5.82%) are its named shareholders, the rest is free float.
